facts.text: In Feb 2025 Kevin wanted to run local models. Mia told him she runs Qwen 7B on her 32GB Mac to tag links and offered him her prompt.

evidence.quote: 我的 Mac 32GB 内存跑 8B 很流畅
这是我的 prompt 你直接拿去改嘛

facts.text: Kevin connected his Obsidian notes to Claude through a local MCP server. Mia also wanted to do this but worried it would change her notes, and she liked his read-only idea.

evidence.quote: 我之前也想接 Obsidian 但是怕它乱改我的笔记
read-only 好主意！我也去加一个

facts.text: Kevin uses Claude Code subagents. Mia suggested giving each agent its own directory, written in CLAUDE.md and enforced by a hook, and sent him a repo with example hooks.

evidence.quote: 然后再加一个 hook，改了别人的目录就直接 block 掉。
这个 repo 里有好几个 改改就能用嘛

facts.text: Mia wished Kevin a happy Mid-Autumn Festival in Oct 2025 and recommended the Maxim's (美心) custard mooncakes from Costco, in the red box. 你们 suggests he lives with family.

evidence.quote: 中秋快乐！
美心的 红色盒子那个

facts.text: Kevin's team does LLM-as-judge and was using the same model as both judge and the model being tested. Mia's advice: score pass/fail, ask about each criterion separately, use a different judge model, and hand-check 100 samples.

evidence.quote: 我们当时是把打分改成 pass/fail
换一个 model 当 judge 再抽一百条人工对一下

facts.text: Kevin uses an MCP to fill in forms, including tax forms. Mia raised privacy concerns.

evidence.quote: 尤其是税务的话，你不担心隐私问题吗？

facts.text: Kevin records his own podcast and wants to publish transcripts. Mia shared her Whisper + Claude pipeline: put a glossary at the top of the prompt and tell the model not to polish the text.

evidence.quote: 对！放在 prompt 最前面 几十个词
不过记得在 prompt 里让它别润色。

facts.text: Mia's tone with Kevin is relaxed and peer-to-peer. She often opens questions with 好奇 and uses 😂.

evidence.quote: 好奇它搜索是用 embedding 还是直接 grep?
不然最后 merge 的时候很崩溃😂
